lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Wednesday's Parks and Recreation Commission meeting, where commissioners will take up the already-approved but deeply contested plan to pave Town Park's grass oval for basketball and pickleball courts — a project that's drawn more than 400 signatures in opposition. The TMVOA Board also meets Thursday with proposed amendments to its fiscal policies on the table, and the San Miguel Basin Fair and Rodeo kicks off Friday alongside the New York Philharmonic Brass Quintet as part of the summer music stretch.

notable.stake: Commissioners revisit paving Town Park oval despite 400+ signatures opposing it.
Board votes on officer elections and proposed fiscal policy amendments.
